title: VerifyReport
description: Report written by tools/edikt/internal/verify/reporter.go (verify.Report) after `bin/edikt verify` runs a plan's criteria sidecar. Written as a pair of files, JSON + human-readable .txt, under .edikt/state/verify/. Filename convention: for a single-phase run, `<PlanID>-phase-<N>-<timestamp>.json` (and matching .txt); for a full run across all phases, `<PlanID>-all-<timestamp>.json`. <timestamp> is UTC, formatted `20060102T150405Z` (Go reference layout). This schema pins the JSON sibling only; the .txt file is a rendered, non-machine-readable summary. Consumed by commands/sdlc/post-flight.md's L1 (criteria verify) stage, which globs this directory for the most recent report matching the active plan and phase.

plan_id.description: The plan identifier this report was run against, e.g. PLAN-v072-defect-sweep. Matches the criteria sidecar's plan field and the <PlanID> filename segment.

phase.description: The phase id this run covered (e.g. "3"), or the literal string "all" for a full-plan run across every phase. Drives which filename form WriteReports uses.

ran_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) when the run started.

ran_by.description: "<user>@<host>" identity of whoever/whatever invoked the runner, or "?" for either component that could not be resolved.

git_sha.description: The git commit SHA the working tree was at when the run executed. May be empty when run outside a git repo.

summary.description: Aggregate counts across criteria, computed by Report.BuildSummary from the criteria list — never hand-authored.

criteria.description: Per-criterion outcome, one entry per AC in the plan's criteria sidecar, in sidecar order.

id.description: Criterion id, e.g. AC-3.1, matching the criteria sidecar.

statement.description: Human-readable statement of what the criterion asserts, copied from the criteria sidecar.

status.description: Outcome of running the criterion's verify command under bash -c.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time the verify command took to run, in milliseconds.

stdout_excerpt.description: Captured stdout excerpt from the verify command (empty string when not applicable, e.g. passed/skipped).

stderr_excerpt.description: Captured stderr excerpt from the verify command (empty string when not applicable).

exit_code.description: Process exit code of the verify command.
